text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!
No way, is my skin breaking out?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to get plenty of sleep,
and I definitely put on moisturizer too!
Why, oh why is this happening~?!
choice_data_list: Is there anything you can think of feng shui-wise?
Is there anything you can think of feng shui-wise?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "In feng shui, it's said that messy water areas lead to rough skin. Like faucets, sinks, vanities, and bathtubs, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been so busy lately that I've only been
checking the water troughs every few days...
I need to give them a thorough inspection today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, the north, which has strong Water Qi, and the southwest, where Earth overcomes Water—
Uuugh, Rickey, fight on~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her dejected figure walk away,
I silently prayed for her rough skin
to heal as soon as possible.
